$comment: Realistic dummy Singapore vendor dataset for the SF->Dataverse Loom demo. All company names, UENs, and Salesforce IDs are INVENTED — format is plausible but the numbers are made up. Coexists with (does not clobber) the existing e2e test vendor 'SF Apex Live Vendor' / UEN APEXLIVE001 / SF ID 001apexlive.
$distribution: Target Dataverse sync-status mix: 15 Synced, 3 Pending, 4 Error. Synced rows come naturally from a happy-path sync (or are upserted as Synced by seed-dataverse.js); the 3 Pending + 4 Error are injected post-hoc by vary-status.js to give the Copilot agent / Canvas app / Power BI report a varied, demo-worthy picture rather than a wall of identical 'Synced' rows.
$linkageNote: LINKAGE (B1): by default seed-dataverse.js resolves the REAL Salesforce Account.Id for each vendor by shelling out to `sf data query` (SOQL re-query by UEN) and uses that real Id as the Dataverse alt-key value. So crfe6_salesforceid in Dataverse ends up holding the actual Salesforce Id — a side-by-side Loom shot of the SF Account list and the Dataverse gallery lines up. The synthetic salesforceId values below (001SEED01…) are FALLBACKS, used only when (a) --use-synthetic-ids is passed (dry-runs without SF auth), or (b) the SF resolver finds no row for a given UEN.
$currencyRationale: Mostly SGD (env default). A few non-SGD (USD/MYR/EUR) are cosmetic field variety only. NOTE: the Azure Function does NOT error on an unmapped currency — dataverseSync.js:70-74 logs 'Skipping currency bind' and proceeds to stamp Synced. So currency mismatches are NOT an Error cause under real sync; do not use currency as a Phase-2 Error narrative. (Sentosa Fresh Catering's Error note below was retargeted to a non-currency cause for this reason.)
$timestampRationale: lastModifiedHoursAgo is a relative offset; the seeding scripts compute the actual ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at runtime from now, so the Power BI Sync Health trend always spans the last ~14 days regardless of when the demo is recorded.
$uenFormat: Singapore local-company UENs look like 20YYNNNNN<letter> (or 19YY... for older firms). Values below are fabricated but format-correct and unique within this set. UEN__c field length is 18; all values are 10 chars.
